name: Lyn
title: Wind Moon Sect
description: An instructor of the children's class at the Wind Moon Sect. Having taught etiquette and martial arts to children, she often treats others as if she was handling kids.
introduction:
A girl from the Wind Moon Sect, a martial art sect hailing from the Eastern Continent beyond the sea.

Before coming to NOA, Lyn taught etiquette and martial arts to young children at the Wind Moon Sect, so she often slips into the tone she used when speaking to kids.
Her motto is <color=#2A80D8>"Good medicine always tastes bitter."</color> She values health so highly that she adds medicinal herbs and ingredients to everything she eats. Once, she prepared a health-focused meal for the children and ended up turning mealtime into a sea of tears.

One day, as Lyn gazed up at the moon from a pavilion, an invitation to the Journey arrived for her.
